meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (via the local Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Final as printed; the RBI's annual table is its own and can differ from the sum of months, which is disclosed, never reconciled.
meta.coverage: The RBI's older, fuller table of new capital issues, April 1990 to November 2024: equity at a premium, preference shares, debentures by convertibility and by mode
meta.note: The detailed layout the RBI ran beside the current one until November 2024; a different table, never joined to markets-issues. In November 2024 debentures (4 issues, ₹380.3 crore) do not equal convertible plus non-convertible (0 + 2 issues, ₹217.77 crore) as printed. Items printed under the debentures heading as 'a) Prospectus' and 'b) Rights' are zero in some months with debenture issues (from July 2022): as printed.
